<thought>The 13C NMR spectrum shows a single upfield carbon signal at 20.67 ppm, which is characteristic of a methyl carbon. No other methyl‑type carbon signals are present, indicating that the molecule contains one methyl carbon environment. Assuming the methyl groups are not chemically equivalent (which would merge signals), the count of methyl groups is therefore 1.</thought>
<final_answer>1</final_answer>
